remarks: Spacious single family home on cul-de-sac in desirable mid-Ridges neighborhood. This home has 3 bedrooms on the main level with 1.5 bathrooms and 2 additional bedrooms and a bathroom on the second level, which has a kitchenette and separate entrance. Perfect for a generational living or for additional guests. The appliances are all newer and the washer and dryer are in the basement. This home features off-street parking and a large, level, fenced in back yard with a deck. This home and the location can't be beat. Available September 1.
